_timing: No narration yet. Each beat is the larger of the time it needs to finish animating and the time it takes to read, plus a 22-frame hold. This is a floor, not considered pacing — measure a real read and switch this topic to voiceCuts.

beats.text: Wait for the marshmallow and you will succeed in life.
beats.note: Early studies reported correlations of .57 with SAT maths and .42 with SAT verbal.

beats.context: The sample in the 2018 replication. Delay was measured at 54 months old, then the children were followed to age 15.

beats.text: The link was only half the size.
beats.note: The authors say the raw association was only half the size of those in the original studies.

beats.text: Control for family and early ability, and it shrinks by about two thirds.
beats.note: For children whose mothers had not completed college, the age 15 coefficient fell from 0.236 to 0.081.

beats.text: Include thinking and behaviour at 54 months, and it is no longer significant.
beats.note: The coefficient fell to 0.050, with a p value of 0.14.

beats.text: Waiting told you much less once you knew the child's background.
